What I am looking for is for you to build a python script that when run (double clicked on) it will create a brand excel file that lists each item from the auction, their current bid, and what they are projected to be worth. 
Do that first for auction ID 164145.

import os
import sys

def get_auction_data(auction_id):

    base_url = "https://bid.theconsignors.com/api/items/search"
    all_items = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        params = {
            "auction_id": auction_id,
            "query": "",
            "category": "All",
            "page": "active",
            "per_page": 100,
            "exact_category_match": "true"
        }

        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=10)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            if not data.get("items"):
                break

            all_items.extend(data["items"])

            # Check if we have more pages
            if len(data["items"]) < 100 or len(all_items) >= data.get("total", 0):
                break

            page += 1
            params["page"] = page

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fetching page {page}: {e}")
            break

    return all_items

def create_excel(auction_id, items):

    for idx, item in enumerate(items, start=2):

        name = item.get("name", "")

        current_bid = item.get("current_bid", 0)
        if current_bid is None:
            current_bid = 0

        ws[f"A{idx}"] = lot_num
        ws[f"B{idx}"] = name
        ws[f"C{idx}"] = current_bid
        ws[f"D{idx}"] = ""  # Projected worth (user to fill in)

        ws[f"D{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        # Apply borders

            if col in ["C", "D"]:

    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 40
    ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["D"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["E"].width = 30

    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_{timestamp}.xlsx"
    filepath = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Desktop", filename)

    wb.save(filepath)
    return filepath

import requests
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from datetime import datetime
import os
import sys
import warnings

# Suppress SSL warnings
urllib3 = __import__('urllib3')
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

def get_auction_data(auction_id):
    """Fetch all items from the auction API"""
    base_url = "https://bid.theconsignors.com/api/items/search"
    all_items = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        params = {
            "auction_id": auction_id,
            "query": "",
            "category": "All",
            "page": "active",
            "per_page": 100,
            "exact_category_match": "true"
        }

        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            if not data.get("items"):
                break

            all_items.extend(data["items"])

            # Check if we have more pages
            if len(data["items"]) < 100 or len(all_items) >= data.get("total", 0):
                break

            page += 1
            params["page"] = page

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fetching page {page}: {e}")
            break

    return all_items

def create_excel(auction_id, items):
    """Create an Excel file with auction data"""

    # Create workbook
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Auction Items"

    # Define styles
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=12)
    border = Border(
        left=Side(style='thin'),
        right=Side(style='thin'),
        top=Side(style='thin'),
        bottom=Side(style='thin')
    )

    # Set headers
    headers = ["Lot #", "Item Name", "Current Bid", "Projected Worth", "Notes"]
    ws.append(headers)

    # Style headers
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
        cell.border = border

    # Add data
    for idx, item in enumerate(items, start=2):
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
        name = item.get("name", "")

        # Get current bid - need to check the data structure
        current_bid = item.get("current_bid", 0)
        if current_bid is None:
            current_bid = 0

        ws[f"A{idx}"] = lot_num
        ws[f"B{idx}"] = name
        ws[f"C{idx}"] = current_bid
        ws[f"D{idx}"] = ""  # Projected worth (user to fill in)
        ws[f"E{idx}"] = ""  # Notes

        # Format currency columns
        if isinstance(current_bid, (int, float)) and current_bid > 0:
            ws[f"C{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        ws[f"D{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        # Apply borders
        for col in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]:
            ws[f"{col}{idx}"].border = border
            if col in ["C", "D"]:
                ws[f"{col}{idx}"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")

    # Adjust column widths
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 8
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 40
    ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["D"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["E"].width = 30

    # Freeze header row
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"

    # Save file
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_{timestamp}.xlsx"
    filepath = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Desktop", filename)

    wb.save(filepath)
    return filepath

def main():
    auction_id = "164145"

    items = get_auction_data(auction_id)

    print(f"File saved to: {filepath}")
    print(f"\nTotal items: {len(items)}")

    input("Press Enter to exit...")

def get_auction_data(auction_id):

        try:

            # Check if we have more pages

            page += 1
            params["page"] = page

        except Exception as e:

import requests
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from datetime import datetime
import os
import sys
import warnings

# Suppress SSL warnings
urllib3 = __import__('urllib3')
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

def get_auction_data(auction_id):
    """Fetch all items from the auction API"""
    base_url = "https://bid.theconsignors.com/api/items/search"
    all_items = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        params = {
            "auction_id": auction_id,
            "query": "",
            "category": "All",
            "page": "active",
            "per_page": 100,
            "exact_category_match": "true"
        }

        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            if not data.get("items"):
                break

            all_items.extend(data["items"])

            # Check if we have more pages
            if len(data["items"]) < 100 or len(all_items) >= data.get("total", 0):
                break

            page += 1
            params["page"] = page

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fetching page {page}: {e}")
            break

    return all_items

def create_excel(auction_id, items):
    """Create an Excel file with auction data"""

    # Create workbook
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Auction Items"

    # Define styles
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=12)
    border = Border(
        left=Side(style='thin'),
        right=Side(style='thin'),
        top=Side(style='thin'),
        bottom=Side(style='thin')
    )

    # Set headers
    headers = ["Lot #", "Item Name", "Current Bid", "Projected Worth", "Notes"]
    ws.append(headers)

    # Style headers
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")
        cell.border = border

    # Add data
    for idx, item in enumerate(items, start=2):
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
        name = item.get("name", "")

        # Get current bid from api_bidding_state, or fall back to start_amount
        bidding_state = item.get("api_bidding_state", {})
        high_bid = bidding_state.get("high")
        if high_bid and isinstance(high_bid, dict):
            current_bid = high_bid.get("amount", 0)
        else:
            current_bid = item.get("start_amount", 0)

        # Get projected worth from high_estimate in bidding_configuration
        bidding_config = item.get("bidding_configuration", {})
        projected_worth = bidding_config.get("high_estimate")

        ws[f"A{idx}"] = lot_num
        ws[f"B{idx}"] = name
        ws[f"C{idx}"] = current_bid if current_bid else ""
        ws[f"D{idx}"] = projected_worth if projected_worth else ""
        ws[f"E{idx}"] = ""  # Notes

        # Format currency columns
        if isinstance(current_bid, (int, float)) and current_bid and current_bid > 0:
            ws[f"C{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        if isinstance(projected_worth, (int, float)) and projected_worth and projected_worth > 0:
            ws[f"D{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        # Apply borders
        for col in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]:
            ws[f"{col}{idx}"].border = border
            if col in ["C", "D"]:
                ws[f"{col}{idx}"].alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")

    # Adjust column widths
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 8
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 40
    ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["D"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["E"].width = 30

    # Freeze header row
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"

    # Save file - try Desktop, then Documents, then current directory
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_{timestamp}.xlsx"

    # Try Desktop first
    desktop_path = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), "Desktop")
    if os.path.exists(desktop_path):
        filepath = os.path.join(desktop_path, filename)
    else:
        # Fall back to current directory
        filepath = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), filename)

    wb.save(filepath)
    return filepath

def main():
    auction_id = "164145"

    print(f"Fetching auction data for auction ID: {auction_id}...")
    items = get_auction_data(auction_id)

    if not items:
        print("No items found!")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        return

    print(f"Found {len(items)} items. Creating Excel file...")
    filepath = create_excel(auction_id, items)

    print(f"Excel file created successfully!")
    print(f"File saved to: {filepath}")
    print(f"\nTotal items: {len(items)}")

    input("Press Enter to exit...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

input.content:
# Auction Data Exporter

A Python script that scrapes auction data from The Consignors Online Auction House and creates an Excel file with item details.

## Quick Start

**Double-click on `run_auction_scraper.bat`** to run the script.

## Features

- Automatically fetches all auction items from The Consignors
- Extracts item lot numbers, names, and current bids
- Creates a professionally formatted Excel file
- Can be customized for different auction IDs

## How to Use

### Option 1: Double-Click (Easiest)
1. Double-click `run_auction_scraper.bat`
2. When prompted, enter the auction ID or press Enter to use the default (164145)
3. The script will create an Excel file and save it to the same folder

### Option 2: Command Line
Run with a specific auction ID:
```
run_auction_scraper.bat 164145
```

## Excel File Format

The created Excel file contains the following columns:

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Lot # | The lot number from the auction |
| Item Name | Full description of the item |
| Current Bid | Current bid amount (automatically populated) |
| Projected Worth | Space for you to enter estimated values |
| Notes | Your personal notes about the item |

## Requirements

- Python 3.7+ (download from https://www.python.org/downloads/)
- Internet connection to fetch auction data

The script will automatically install required Python packages (openpyxl, requests) if they're missing.

## Finding Auction IDs

To find the auction ID from a URL like `https://bid.theconsignors.com/ui/auctions/164145`:
- The auction ID is the number at the end: **164145**

## Troubleshooting

### "Python not found" error
- Install Python from https://www.python.org/downloads/
- **Important**: During installation, check the box "Add Python to PATH"
- After installation, restart any command windows or close and reopen the batch file

### "Connection error" or "SSL error"
- Check your internet connection
- The script uses HTTPS and may need to verify SSL certificates
- This usually resolves itself on the second attempt

### Excel file is blank
- Check that you're using a valid auction ID
- Visit https://bid.theconsignors.com/ui to verify the auction exists

## Notes

- The script fetches data from the live auction site, so it shows current bids at the time of execution

A Python script that scrapes auction data from The Consignors Online Auction House and creates an Excel file with item details.

## Quick Start

**Double-click on `run_auction_scraper.bat`** to run the script.

## Features

- Automatically fetches all auction items from The Consignors
- Extracts item lot numbers, names, and current bids
- Creates a professionally formatted Excel file
- Can be customized for different auction IDs

## How to Use

### Option 1: Double-Click (Easiest)
1. Double-click `run_auction_scraper.bat`
2. When prompted, enter the auction ID or press Enter to use the default (164145)
3. The script will create an Excel file and save it to the same folder

### Option 2: Command Line
Run with a specific auction ID:

```
run_auction_scraper.bat 164145
```

The created Excel file contains the following columns:

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Lot # | The lot number from the auction |
| Item Name | Full description of the item |
| Current Bid | Current bid amount (automatically populated) |
| Projected Worth | Space for you to enter estimated values |
| Notes | Your personal notes about the item |

- Python 3.7+ (download from https://www.python.org/downloads/)
- Internet connection to fetch auction data

To find the auction ID from a URL like `https://bid.theconsignors.com/ui/auctions/164145`:

- This usually resolves itself on the second attempt

- Check that you're using a valid auction ID
- Visit https://bid.theconsignors.com/ui to verify the auction exists

# Auction Re-Analysis Toolkit

This bundle recreates the workflow we used on The Consignors Auction #160623, but parameterized so you can run it again with a different auction ID.

## What it does
1. Opens the auction page for a new auction ID.
2. Captures the site/API JSON from browser network calls.
3. Normalizes lots into a clean table.
4. Downloads all lot images into folders by lot number.
5. Builds an Excel workbook.
6. Optionally runs AI image/value analysis if you provide an OpenAI-compatible API key.
7. Builds a local dashboard (`auction_data.json` + `index.html`) similar to the prior Auction Command Center.

## Quick start

```bash
python -m venv .venv
.venv\Scripts\activate  # Windows
# source .venv/bin/activate  # macOS/Linux
pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m playwright install chromium
```

Then edit `.env`:

```env
AUCTION_ID=REPLACE_WITH_NEW_AUCTION_ID
AUCTION_BASE_URL=https://bid.theconsignors.com/ui/auctions
BUYER_PREMIUM=0.13
SALES_TAX=0.075
OPENAI_API_KEY=
OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4.1-mini
```

Run everything:

```bash
python run_auction_pipeline.py
```

Outputs go into `output/`:
- `raw_network_json/` — captured API/browser JSON
- `auction_lots_normalized.csv`
- `auction_lots.xlsx`
- `images/<lot_number>/...jpg`
- `price_analysis.csv` if AI analysis is enabled
- `dashboard/auction_data.json`
- `dashboard/index.html`

## Notes
- If the auction site changes its internal API, `01_capture_auction_json.py` still works by capturing browser network traffic and recursively finding lot-like records.
- The previous auction transcript used 13% buyer premium from the site terms and 7.5% NC tax in the captured page source, while the saved pricing-methodology transcript also mentions default 18% buyer premium. Update `.env` for the actual auction you are analyzing.
- Use this only for public/authorized pages and respect the auction site’s terms.

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

STEPS = [
    "01_capture_auction_json.py",
    "02_build_excel.py",
    "03_download_images.py",
    # AI step is optional; run separately after setting OPENAI_API_KEY if desired.
    "05_make_dashboard.py",
]


def run(script):
    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print(f"Running {script}")
    print("=" * 80)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, script], check=True)


def main():
    if not Path(".env").exists() and Path(".env.example").exists():
        Path(".env").write_text(Path(".env.example").read_text(encoding="utf-8"), encoding="utf-8")
        print("Created .env from .env.example. Edit AUCTION_ID in .env before rerunning if needed.")
    for s in STEPS:
        run(s)
    print("\nDone. Check the output/ folder.")
    print("If you want AI price estimates, set OPENAI_API_KEY and run: python 04_estimate_prices_with_ai.py")
    print("Then rerun: python 05_make_dashboard.py")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import asyncio
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List
from urllib.parse import urlparse

import pandas as pd
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

from config import AUCTION_URL, RAW_DIR, OUTPUT_DIR

LOT_KEYS = {
    "lot", "lot_number", "lotNumber", "lot_identifier", "lotIdentifier", "number",
    "title", "name", "description", "current_bid", "currentBid", "askingPrice",
    "images", "image", "photos", "assets", "listing_images", "item_images"
}

IMAGE_EXT_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\"'<>\\\s]+(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp)(?:\?[^\"'<>\\\s]*)?", re.I)


def save_json(obj: Any, prefix: str) -> Path:
    existing = len(list(RAW_DIR.glob(f"{prefix}_*.json")))
    out = RAW_DIR / f"{prefix}_{existing+1:03d}.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return out


def walk(obj: Any) -> Iterable[Any]:
    yield obj
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        for v in obj.values():
            yield from walk(v)
    elif isinstance(obj, list):
        for v in obj:
            yield from walk(v)


def looks_like_lot(d: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    keys = set(d.keys())
    has_lot_id = bool(keys & {"lot", "lot_number", "lotNumber", "lot_identifier", "lotIdentifier", "number"})
    has_title = bool(keys & {"title", "name", "description"})
    has_imageish = bool(keys & {"images", "image", "photos", "assets", "listing_images", "item_images"})
    return has_lot_id and (has_title or has_imageish)


def first_present(d: Dict[str, Any], names: List[str], default=""):
    for n in names:
        if n in d and d[n] not in [None, ""]:
            return d[n]
    return default


def collect_image_urls(obj: Any) -> List[str]:
    urls = []
    # URLs in stringified object catches transformed CloudFront URLs too.
    text = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False) if not isinstance(obj, str) else obj
    urls.extend(IMAGE_EXT_RE.findall(text))
    # De-duplicate preserving order

import pandas as pd
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

from config import OUTPUT_DIR, BUYER_PREMIUM, SALES_TAX

INPUT = OUTPUT_DIR / "auction_lots_normalized.csv"
OUTPUT = OUTPUT_DIR / "auction_lots.xlsx"


def clean_money(x):
    if pd.isna(x) or x == "":
        return ""
    s = str(x).replace("$", "").replace(",", "").strip()
    try:
        return float(s)
    except Exception:
        return x


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(INPUT, dtype=str).fillna("")
    if "current_bid" in df.columns:
        df["current_bid"] = df["current_bid"].map(clean_money)

    # Analysis columns to fill manually or via AI step.
    for col in [
        "estimated_actual_value", "reasonable_low", "reasonable_high", "confidence",
        "pricing_notes", "watchlist_tier", "personal_use_max_bid", "resell_max_bid", "suggested_max_bid"
    ]:
        if col not in df.columns:
            df[col] = ""

    df.to_excel(OUTPUT, index=False, sheet_name="All Lots", engine="openpyxl")
    wb = load_workbook(OUTPUT)
    ws = wb["All Lots"]
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
    ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions

    # Header styling
    fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F2937")
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.font = Font(color="FFFFFF", bold=True)
        cell.fill = fill
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")

    widths = {
        "A": 12, "B": 45, "C": 70, "D": 14, "E": 12, "F": 80,
        "G": 40, "H": 70, "I": 18, "J": 16, "K": 16, "L": 14,
        "M": 70, "N": 16, "O": 18, "P": 18, "Q": 18,
    }
    for col, width in widths.items():
        ws.column_dimensions[col].width = width

    ws2 = wb.create_sheet("Bid Math")
    ws2.append(["Input", "Value"])
    ws2.append(["Buyer Premium", BUYER_PREMIUM])
    ws2.append(["Sales Tax", SALES_TAX])
    ws2.append(["All-in Multiplier", f"=1+B2+B3"])
    ws2.append(["Personal Use Rule", "80%-90% of actual value, divided by all-in multiplier"])
    ws2.append(["Resell Rule", "50%-60% of actual value, divided by all-in multiplier"])
    for row in ws2.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=6):
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)
    ws2.column_dimensions["A"].width = 26
    ws2.column_dimensions["B"].width = 80

    wb.save(OUTPUT)
    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import requests
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from datetime import datetime
import os
import sys
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

# Suppress SSL warnings
urllib3 = __import__('urllib3')
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

# Load environment variables if .env exists
try:
    from dotenv import load_dotenv
    load_dotenv()
except ImportError:
    pass

# Configuration
AUCTION_ID = os.getenv("AUCTION_ID", "164145").strip()
BUYER_PREMIUM = float(os.getenv("BUYER_PREMIUM", "0.13"))
SALES_TAX = float(os.getenv("SALES_TAX", "0.075"))
DOWNLOAD_IMAGES = os.getenv("DOWNLOAD_IMAGES", "false").lower() == "true"

def get_auction_data(auction_id):
    """Fetch all items from the auction API"""
    base_url = "https://bid.theconsignors.com/api/items/search"
    all_items = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        params = {
            "auction_id": auction_id,
            "query": "",
            "category": "All",
            "page": "active",
            "per_page": 100,
            "exact_category_match": "true"
        }

        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            if not data.get("items"):
                break

            all_items.extend(data["items"])

            # Check if we have more pages
            if len(data["items"]) < 100 or len(all_items) >= data.get("total", 0):
                break

            page += 1
            params["page"] = page

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fetching page {page}: {e}")
            break

    return all_items

def download_item_images(item, output_dir):
    """Download images for a single item"""
    lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "").replace("/", "-")
    if not lot_num:
        return 0

    images = item.get("images", [])
    if not images:
        return 0

    lot_dir = output_dir / f"lot_{lot_num}"
    lot_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    count = 0
    for idx, img in enumerate(images, 1):
        try:
            img_url = img.get("full_preview_url") or img.get("url")
            if not img_url:
                continue

            response = requests.get(img_url, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()

            # Save image
            ext = ".jpg"
            if "png" in img_url.lower():
                ext = ".png"
            elif "webp" in img_url.lower():
                ext = ".webp"

            filepath = lot_dir / f"image_{idx:02d}{ext}"
            filepath.write_bytes(response.content)
            count += 1

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  Warning: Failed to download image {idx}: {e}")

    return count

def create_excel(auction_id, items, download_images=False):
    """Create an Excel file with auction data"""

    output_dir = Path.cwd() / "auction_exports"
    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    images_dir = None
    if download_images:
        images_dir = output_dir / f"auction_{auction_id}_images"

    # Create workbook
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    wb.remove(wb.active)  # Remove default sheet

    # Create All Items sheet
    ws_items = wb.create_sheet("All Lots")

    # Define styles
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F2937", end_color="1F2937", fill_type="solid")
    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
    border = Border(
        left=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        right=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        top=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        bottom=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3')
    )

    # Set headers for items sheet
    headers = [
        "Lot #", "Item Name", "Description", "Current Bid",
        "Estimated Value", "Low Est", "High Est",
        "Your Max Bid", "Notes", "Image Count"
    ]
    ws_items.append(headers)

    # Style headers
    for cell in ws_items[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
        cell.border = border

    # Add data
    image_count_total = 0
    for idx, item in enumerate(items, start=2):
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
        name = item.get("name", "")
        description = item.get("simple_description", "")[:200] if item.get("simple_description") else ""

        # Get current bid
        bidding_state = item.get("api_bidding_state", {})
        high_bid = bidding_state.get("high")
        if high_bid and isinstance(high_bid, dict):
            current_bid = high_bid.get("amount", 0)
        else:
            current_bid = item.get("start_amount", 0)

        # Get estimates
        bidding_config = item.get("bidding_configuration", {})
        low_est = bidding_config.get("low_estimate")
        high_est = bidding_config.get("high_estimate")

        # Count images
        image_count = len(item.get("images", []))
        image_count_total += image_count

        ws_items[f"A{idx}"] = lot_num
        ws_items[f"B{idx}"] = name
        ws_items[f"C{idx}"] = description
        ws_items[f"D{idx}"] = current_bid if current_bid else ""
        ws_items[f"E{idx}"] = ""  # User fills in estimated value
        ws_items[f"F{idx}"] = low_est if low_est else ""
        ws_items[f"G{idx}"] = high_est if high_est else ""
        ws_items[f"H{idx}"] = ""  # User fills in max bid
        ws_items[f"I{idx}"] = ""  # Notes
        ws_items[f"J{idx}"] = image_count if image_count > 0 else ""

        # Format currency columns
        for col in ["D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
            ws_items[f"{col}{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        # Apply borders and alignment
        for col_idx, col_letter in enumerate(["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H", "I", "J"]):
            cell = ws_items[f"{col_letter}{idx}"]
            cell.border = border
            if col_letter in ["D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
            elif col_letter in ["B", "C", "I"]:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", wrap_text=True)

    # Set column widths
    ws_items.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    ws_items.column_dimensions["B"].width = 40
    ws_items.column_dimensions["C"].width = 35
    ws_items.column_dimensions["D"].width = 14
    ws_items.column_dimensions["E"].width = 14
    ws_items.column_dimensions["F"].width = 12
    ws_items.column_dimensions["G"].width = 12
    ws_items.column_dimensions["H"].width = 14
    ws_items.column_dimensions["I"].width = 25
    ws_items.column_dimensions["J"].width = 12

    # Freeze header row and add filter
    ws_items.freeze_panes = "A2"
    ws_items.auto_filter.ref = ws_items.dimensions

    # Create Bid Math sheet
    ws_math = wb.create_sheet("Bid Math", 1)
    ws_math.append(["Auction Bidding Math Calculator"])
    ws_math.append([])
    ws_math.append(["Input", "Value"])
    ws_math["A3"].font = Font(bold=True)
    ws_math["B3"].font = Font(bold=True)
    ws_math.append(["Buyer Premium %", f"{BUYER_PREMIUM * 100:.1f}%"])
    ws_math.append(["Sales Tax %", f"{SALES_TAX * 100:.1f}%"])
    ws_math.append(["All-in Multiplier", f"=1+0.{int(BUYER_PREMIUM*100)}+0.{int(SALES_TAX*100)}"])
    ws_math.append([])
    ws_math.append(["Bidding Rules", "Formula"])
    ws_math["A8"].font = Font(bold=True)
    ws_math["B8"].font = Font(bold=True)
    ws_math.append(["Personal Use (80% Rule)", "= (Item Value * 0.80) / All-in Multiplier"])
    ws_math.append(["Personal Use (90% Rule)", "= (Item Value * 0.90) / All-in Multiplier"])
    ws_math.append(["Resell (50% Rule)", "= (Item Value * 0.50) / All-in Multiplier"])
    ws_math.append(["Resell (60% Rule)", "= (Item Value * 0.60) / All-in Multiplier"])

    for row in ws_math.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)

    ws_math.column_dimensions["A"].width = 30
    ws_math.column_dimensions["B"].width = 50

    # Save file
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_{timestamp}.xlsx"
    filepath = output_dir / filename

    wb.save(filepath)

    return filepath, images_dir if download_images else None

def main():
    # Get auction ID from command line or prompt user
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        auction_id = sys.argv[1]
    else:
        print("=" * 60)
        print("AUCTION DATA EXPORTER - ENHANCED")
        print("=" * 60)
        print(f"\nDefault Auction ID: {AUCTION_ID}")
        print("Buyer Premium: {:.1f}%".format(BUYER_PREMIUM * 100))
        print("Sales Tax: {:.1f}%".format(SALES_TAX * 100))
        print("\nEnter auction ID or press Enter to use default")
        user_input = input("Auction ID: ").strip()
        auction_id = user_input if user_input else AUCTION_ID

    print(f"\nFetching auction data for auction ID: {auction_id}...")
    items = get_auction_data(auction_id)

    if not items:
        print("No items found!")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        return

    print(f"Found {len(items)} items. Creating Excel file...")
    excel_path, images_dir = create_excel(auction_id, items, download_images=DOWNLOAD_IMAGES)

    if DOWNLOAD_IMAGES and images_dir:
        print(f"Downloading images...")
        total_images = 0
        for idx, item in enumerate(items, 1):
            if idx % 50 == 0:
                print(f"  Processing item {idx}/{len(items)}...")
            count = download_item_images(item, images_dir)
            total_images += count
        print(f"Downloaded {total_images} images")

    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"Excel file created successfully!")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"\nFile location: {excel_path}")
    print(f"Total items: {len(items)}")
    if DOWNLOAD_IMAGES:
        print(f"Images folder: {images_dir}")
    print(f"\nSheets:")
    print(f"  - All Lots: Complete auction inventory with filtering")
    print(f"  - Bid Math: Calculation reference for your bidding strategy")

    input("\nPress Enter to exit...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        high_est = bidding_config.get("high_estimate")

        # Count images
        image_count = len(item.get("images", []))
        image_count_total += image_count

        ws_items[f"A{idx}"] = lot_num
        ws_items[f"B{idx}"] = name
        ws_items[f"C{idx}"] = description
        ws_items[f"D{idx}"] = current_bid if current_bid else ""
        ws_items[f"E{idx}"] = ""  # User fills in estimated value
        ws_items[f"F{idx}"] = low_est if low_est else ""
        ws_items[f"G{idx}"] = high_est if high_est else ""
        ws_items[f"H{idx}"] = ""  # User fills in max bid
        ws_items[f"I{idx}"] = ""  # Notes
        ws_items[f"J{idx}"] = image_count if image_count > 0 else ""

        # Format currency columns
        for col in ["D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
            ws_items[f"{col}{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        # Apply borders and alignment
        for col_idx, col_letter in enumerate(["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H", "I", "J"]):
            cell = ws_items[f"{col_letter}{idx}"]
            cell.border = border
            if col_letter in ["D", "E", "F", "G", "H"]:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
            elif col_letter in ["B", "C", "I"]:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", wrap_text=True)

    # Set column widths
    ws_items.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    ws_items.column_dimensions["B"].width = 40
    ws_items.column_dimensions["C"].width = 35
    ws_items.column_dimensions["D"].width = 14

    ws_items.column_dimensions["G"].width = 12
    ws_items.column_dimensions["H"].width = 14
    ws_items.column_dimensions["I"].width = 25
    ws_items.column_dimensions["J"].width = 12

    # Freeze header row and add filter
    ws_items.freeze_panes = "A2"
    ws_items.auto_filter.ref = ws_items.dimensions

    # Create Bid Math sheet
    ws_math = wb.create_sheet("Bid Math", 1)
    ws_math.append(["Auction Bidding Math Calculator"])
    ws_math.append([])
    ws_math.append(["Input", "Value"])
    ws_math["A3"].font = Font(bold=True)
    ws_math["B3"].font = Font(bold=True)
    ws_math.append(["Buyer Premium %", f"{BUYER_PREMIUM * 100:.1f}%"])
    ws_math.append(["Sales Tax %", f"{SALES_TAX * 100:.1f}%"])
    ws_math.append(["All-in Multiplier", f"=1+0.{int(BUYER_PREMIUM*100)}+0.{int(SALES_TAX*100)}"])
    ws_math.append([])
    ws_math.append(["Bidding Rules", "Formula"])
    ws_math["A8"].font = Font(bold=True)
    ws_math["B8"].font = Font(bold=True)
    ws_math.append(["Personal Use (80% Rule)", "= (Item Value * 0.80) / All-in Multiplier"])
    ws_math.append(["Personal Use (90% Rule)", "= (Item Value * 0.90) / All-in Multiplier"])
    ws_math.append(["Resell (50% Rule)", "= (Item Value * 0.50) / All-in Multiplier"])
    ws_math.append(["Resell (60% Rule)", "= (Item Value * 0.60) / All-in Multiplier"])

    for row in ws_math.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            cell.alignment = Alignment(wrap_text=True)

    ws_math.column_dimensions["A"].width = 30
    ws_math.column_dimensions["B"].width = 50

    # Save file
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_{timestamp}.xlsx"
    filepath = output_dir / filename

    wb.save(filepath)

    return filepath, images_dir if download_images else None

# Auction Data Exporter

A Python script that scrapes auction data from The Consignors Online Auction House and creates an Excel file with item details.

## Quick Start

**Double-click on `run_auction_scraper.bat`** to run the script.

## Features

- Automatically fetches all auction items from The Consignors
- Extracts item lot numbers, names, and current bids
- Creates a professionally formatted Excel file
- Can be customized for different auction IDs

## How to Use

### Option 1: Double-Click (Easiest)
1. Double-click `run_auction_scraper.bat`
2. When prompted, enter the auction ID or press Enter to use the default (164145)
3. The script will create an Excel file and save it to the same folder

### Option 2: Command Line
Run with a specific auction ID:
```
run_auction_scraper.bat 164145
```

## Excel File Format

The created Excel file contains the following columns:

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Lot # | The lot number from the auction |
| Item Name | Full description of the item |
| Current Bid | Current bid amount (automatically populated) |
| Projected Worth | Space for you to enter estimated values |
| Notes | Your personal notes about the item |

## Requirements

- Python 3.7+ (download from https://www.python.org/downloads/)
- Internet connection to fetch auction data

The script will automatically install required Python packages (openpyxl, requests) if they're missing.

## Finding Auction IDs

To find the auction ID from a URL like `https://bid.theconsignors.com/ui/auctions/164145`:
- The auction ID is the number at the end: **164145**

## Troubleshooting

### "Python not found" error
- Install Python from https://www.python.org/downloads/
- **Important**: During installation, check the box "Add Python to PATH"
- After installation, restart any command windows or close and reopen the batch file

### "Connection error" or "SSL error"
- Check your internet connection
- The script uses HTTPS and may need to verify SSL certificates
- This usually resolves itself on the second attempt

### Excel file is blank
- Check that you're using a valid auction ID
- Visit https://bid.theconsignors.com/ui to verify the auction exists

## Notes

- The script fetches data from the live auction site, so it shows current bids at the time of execution
- The file is saved in the same folder as the script
- File names include a timestamp, so multiple exports won't overwrite each other
- The "Projected Worth" column is empty by default - fill it in with your estimates

## Support

If you encounter issues:
1. Make sure you have the latest version of Python installed
2. Check that your internet connection is working
3. Try running the batch file as Administrator (right-click → Run as administrator)

---

import requests
import json
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import time
import base64
import os
import sys
import warnings
from anthropic import Anthropic

# Suppress SSL warnings
urllib3 = __import__('urllib3')
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

# Configuration
AUCTION_ID = os.getenv("AUCTION_ID", "164145").strip()

def get_auction_data(auction_id):
    """Fetch all items from the auction API"""
    base_url = "https://bid.theconsignors.com/api/items/search"
    all_items = []

    params = {
        "auction_id": auction_id,
        "query": "",
        "category": "All",
        "page": "active",
        "per_page": 100,
        "exact_category_match": "true"
    }

    page = 1
    while True:
        params["page"] = page
        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            if not data.get("items"):
                break

            all_items.extend(data["items"])

            if len(data["items"]) < 100 or len(all_items) >= data.get("total", 0):
                break

            page += 1

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fetching page {page}: {e}")
            break

    return all_items

def download_item_images(item, images_dir):
    """Download images for a single item and return paths"""
    lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "").replace("/", "-")
    if not lot_num:
        return []

    images = item.get("images", [])
    if not images:
        return []

    lot_dir = images_dir / f"lot_{lot_num}"
    lot_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    image_paths = []
    for idx, img in enumerate(images, 1):
        try:
            img_url = img.get("full_preview_url") or img.get("url")
            if not img_url:
                continue

            response = requests.get(img_url, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()

            # Save image
            ext = ".jpg"
            if "png" in img_url.lower():
                ext = ".png"
            elif "webp" in img_url.lower():
                ext = ".webp"

            filepath = lot_dir / f"image_{idx:02d}{ext}"
            filepath.write_bytes(response.content)
            image_paths.append(str(filepath))

            # Rate limiting
            time.sleep(0.2)

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"    Warning: Failed to download image {idx}: {e}")

    return image_paths

def encode_image_to_base64(image_path):
    """Encode image file to base64"""
    with open(image_path, "rb") as image_file:
        return base64.standard_b64encode(image_file.read()).decode("utf-8")

def get_image_media_type(image_path):
    """Get media type based on file extension"""
    ext = Path(image_path).suffix.lower()
    media_types = {
        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
        ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
        ".png": "image/png",
        ".webp": "image/webp"
    }
    return media_types.get(ext, "image/jpeg")

def analyze_images_with_claude(client, item, image_paths):
    """Analyze item images using Claude and estimate price"""

    if not image_paths:
        return {
            "estimated_price": None,
            "confidence": 0,
            "analysis": "No images available for analysis"
        }

    lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
    item_name = item.get("name", "")
    description = item.get("simple_description", "")

    # Build message with images
    content = []

    # Add item information
    info_text = f"""Please analyze these images of an auction item and provide a price estimate.

ITEM DETAILS:
- Lot #: {lot_num}
- Item Name: {item_name}
- Description: {description[:300] if description else 'N/A'}

Based on the condition, quality, type, and market value visible in the images, please provide:
1. Estimated retail/market value
2. Confidence level (0-100%)
3. Brief analysis of condition and value factors

Format your response as JSON:
{{
    "estimated_price": <number>,
    "confidence": <0-100>,
    "condition_notes": "<brief description>",
    "value_factors": "<key factors affecting price>"
}}"""

    content.append({
        "type": "text",
        "text": info_text
    })

    # Add images (limit to 4 for efficiency)
    for image_path in image_paths[:4]:
        try:
            base64_image = encode_image_to_base64(image_path)
            media_type = get_image_media_type(image_path)

            content.append({
                "type": "image",
                "source": {
                    "type": "base64",
                    "media_type": media_type,
                    "data": base64_image
                }
            })
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"      Error encoding image: {e}")

    try:
        response = client.messages.create(
            model="claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
            max_tokens=500,
            messages=[
                {
                    "role": "user",
                    "content": content
                }
            ]
        )

        response_text = response.content[0].text

        # Try to parse JSON from response
        try:
            # Find JSON in response
            start = response_text.find('{')
            end = response_text.rfind('}') + 1
            if start != -1 and end > start:
                json_str = response_text[start:end]
                analysis = json.loads(json_str)
                return analysis
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            pass

        # If JSON parsing failed, extract values from text
        return {
            "estimated_price": None,
            "confidence": 0,
            "analysis": response_text[:200]
        }

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"      Error analyzing images: {e}")
        return {
            "estimated_price": None,
            "confidence": 0,
            "analysis": f"Analysis error: {str(e)}"
        }

def create_analysis_excel(items_with_analysis, auction_id):
    """Create Excel file with analysis results"""
    import openpyxl
    from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side

    output_dir = Path.cwd() / "auction_exports"
    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Image Analysis"

    # Define styles
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F2937", end_color="1F2937", fill_type="solid")
    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
    border = Border(
        left=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        right=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        top=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        bottom=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3')
    )

    # Set headers
    headers = ["Lot #", "Item Name", "Current Bid", "Claude Est. Price", "Confidence %", "Condition Notes", "Analysis"]
    ws.append(headers)

    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
        cell.border = border

    # Add data
    for idx, item_data in enumerate(items_with_analysis, start=2):
        item = item_data["item"]
        analysis = item_data["analysis"]

        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
        name = item.get("name", "")

        # Get current bid
        bidding_state = item.get("api_bidding_state", {})
        high_bid = bidding_state.get("high")
        if high_bid and isinstance(high_bid, dict):
            current_bid = high_bid.get("amount", 0)
        else:
            current_bid = item.get("start_amount", 0)

        est_price = analysis.get("estimated_price", "")
        confidence = analysis.get("confidence", 0)
        condition = analysis.get("condition_notes", "")
        value_factors = analysis.get("value_factors", "")

        ws[f"A{idx}"] = lot_num
        ws[f"B{idx}"] = name
        ws[f"C{idx}"] = current_bid if current_bid else ""
        ws[f"D{idx}"] = est_price if est_price else ""
        ws[f"E{idx}"] = confidence if confidence else ""
        ws[f"F{idx}"] = condition
        ws[f"G{idx}"] = value_factors

        # Format currency
        ws[f"C{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'
        ws[f"D{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        # Apply borders and alignment
        for col in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"]:
            cell = ws[f"{col}{idx}"]
            cell.border = border
            if col in ["C", "D", "E"]:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
            else:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", wrap_text=True)

    # Set column widths
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 35
    ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 14
    ws.column_dimensions["D"].width = 16
    ws.column_dimensions["E"].width = 12
    ws.column_dimensions["F"].width = 30
    ws.column_dimensions["G"].width = 40

    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"

    # Save file
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_ImageAnalysis_{timestamp}.xlsx"
    filepath = output_dir / filename

    wb.save(filepath)
    return filepath

def main():
    # Get auction ID
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        auction_id = sys.argv[1]
    else:
        print("=" * 70)
        print("IMAGE ANALYZER - Claude Vision-Powered Price Estimation")
        print("=" * 70)
        print(f"\nDefault Auction ID: {AUCTION_ID}")
        print("\nEnter auction ID or press Enter to use default")
        user_input = input("Auction ID: ").strip()
        auction_id = user_input if user_input else AUCTION_ID

    # Initialize Anthropic client
    client = Anthropic()

    # Fetch auction data
    print(f"\nFetching auction data for ID: {auction_id}...")
    items = get_auction_data(auction_id)

    if not items:
        print("No items found!")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        return

    print(f"Found {len(items)} items")

    # Create images directory
    images_dir = Path.cwd() / f"auction_{auction_id}_images_analysis"

    print(f"\nDownloading images (this may take a few minutes)...")
    items_with_images = []

    for idx, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
        item_name = item.get("name", "")

        if idx % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  Progress: {idx}/{len(items)} items...")

        # Download images
        image_paths = download_item_images(item, images_dir)

        if image_paths:
            items_with_images.append({
                "item": item,
                "image_paths": image_paths
            })

    print(f"Downloaded images for {len(items_with_images)} items")

    if not items_with_images:
        print("No images were downloaded!")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        return

    # Analyze images with Claude
    print(f"\nAnalyzing images with Claude Vision (this will take time)...")
    print("Analyzing each image to estimate prices...\n")

    items_with_analysis = []
    for idx, item_data in enumerate(items_with_images, 1):
        item = item_data["item"]
        image_paths = item_data["image_paths"]
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")

        print(f"[{idx}/{len(items_with_images)}] Lot {lot_num}: Analyzing {len(image_paths)} image(s)...", end=" ")

        analysis = analyze_images_with_claude(client, item, image_paths)

        items_with_analysis.append({
            "item": item,
            "analysis": analysis
        })

        est_price = analysis.get("estimated_price", "?")
        confidence = analysis.get("confidence", 0)
        print(f"Est: ${est_price} (Confidence: {confidence}%)")

        # Rate limiting to avoid API overload
        time.sleep(1)

    # Create Excel file
    print(f"\nCreating Excel file with analysis results...")
    excel_path = create_analysis_excel(items_with_analysis, auction_id)

    print(f"\n{'=' * 70}")
    print(f"Analysis Complete!")
    print(f"{'=' * 70}")
    print(f"\nResults saved to: {excel_path}")
    print(f"Images saved to: {images_dir}")
    print(f"\nItems analyzed: {len(items_with_analysis)}")

    input("\nPress Enter to exit...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Image Analysis"

    # Define styles
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F2937", end_color="1F2937", fill_type="solid")
    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
    border = Border(
        left=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        right=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        top=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        bottom=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3')
    )

    # Set headers
    headers = ["Lot #", "Item Name", "Current Bid", "Claude Est. Price", "Confidence %", "Condition Notes", "Analysis"]
    ws.append(headers)

    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
        cell.border = border

    # Add data
    for idx, item_data in enumerate(items_with_analysis, start=2):
        item = item_data["item"]
        analysis = item_data["analysis"]

        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
        name = item.get("name", "")

        # Get current bid
        bidding_state = item.get("api_bidding_state", {})
        high_bid = bidding_state.get("high")
        if high_bid and isinstance(high_bid, dict):
            current_bid = high_bid.get("amount", 0)
        else:
            current_bid = item.get("start_amount", 0)

        est_price = analysis.get("estimated_price", "")
        confidence = analysis.get("confidence", 0)
        condition = analysis.get("condition_notes", "")
        value_factors = analysis.get("value_factors", "")

        ws[f"A{idx}"] = lot_num
        ws[f"B{idx}"] = name
        ws[f"C{idx}"] = current_bid if current_bid else ""
        ws[f"D{idx}"] = est_price if est_price else ""
        ws[f"E{idx}"] = confidence if confidence else ""
        ws[f"F{idx}"] = condition
        ws[f"G{idx}"] = value_factors

        # Format currency
        ws[f"C{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'
        ws[f"D{idx}"].number_format = '$#,##0.00'

        # Apply borders and alignment
        for col in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"]:
            cell = ws[f"{col}{idx}"]
            cell.border = border
            if col in ["C", "D", "E"]:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="right")
            else:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", wrap_text=True)

    # Set column widths
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 35
    ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 14
    ws.column_dimensions["D"].width = 16
    ws.column_dimensions["E"].width = 12
    ws.column_dimensions["F"].width = 30
    ws.column_dimensions["G"].width = 40

    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"

    # Save file
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_ImageAnalysis_{timestamp}.xlsx"
    filepath = output_dir / filename

    wb.save(filepath)
    return filepath

def main():
    # Get auction ID
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        auction_id = sys.argv[1]
    else:
        print("=" * 70)
        print("IMAGE ANALYZER - Claude Vision-Powered Price Estimation")
        print("=" * 70)
        print(f"\nDefault Auction ID: {AUCTION_ID}")
        print("\nEnter auction ID or press Enter to use default")
        user_input = input("Auction ID: ").strip()
        auction_id = user_input if user_input else AUCTION_ID

    # Initialize Anthropic client
    client = Anthropic()

    # Fetch auction data
    print(f"\nFetching auction data for ID: {auction_id}...")
    items = get_auction_data(auction_id)

    if not items:
        print("No items found!")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        return

    print(f"Found {len(items)} items")

    # Create images directory
    images_dir = Path.cwd() / f"auction_{auction_id}_images_analysis"

    print(f"\nDownloading images (this may take a few minutes)...")
    items_with_images = []

    for idx, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
        item_name = item.get("name", "")

        if idx % 50 == 0:
            print(f"  Progress: {idx}/{len(items)} items...")

        # Download images
        image_paths = download_item_images(item, images_dir)

        if image_paths:
            items_with_images.append({
                "item": item,
                "image_paths": image_paths
            })

    print(f"Downloaded images for {len(items_with_images)} items")

    if not items_with_images:
        print("No images were downloaded!")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        return

    # Analyze images with Claude
    print(f"\nAnalyzing images with Claude Vision (this will take time)...")
    print("Analyzing each image to estimate prices...\n")

    items_with_analysis = []
    for idx, item_data in enumerate(items_with_images, 1):
        item = item_data["item"]
        image_paths = item_data["image_paths"]
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")

        print(f"[{idx}/{len(items_with_images)}] Lot {lot_num}: Analyzing {len(image_paths)} image(s)...", end=" ")

        analysis = analyze_images_with_claude(client, item, image_paths)

        items_with_analysis.append({
            "item": item,
            "analysis": analysis
        })

        est_price = analysis.get("estimated_price", "?")
        confidence = analysis.get("confidence", 0)
        print(f"Est: ${est_price} (Confidence: {confidence}%)")

        # Rate limiting to avoid API overload
        time.sleep(1)

    # Create Excel file
    print(f"\nCreating Excel file with analysis results...")
    excel_path = create_analysis_excel(items_with_analysis, auction_id)

    print(f"\n{'=' * 70}")
    print(f"Analysis Complete!")
    print(f"{'=' * 70}")
    print(f"\nResults saved to: {excel_path}")
    print(f"Images saved to: {images_dir}")
    print(f"\nItems analyzed: {len(items_with_analysis)}")

    input("\nPress Enter to exit...")

if __name__ == "__main__":

import requests
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import time
import os
import sys
import warnings

# Suppress SSL warnings
urllib3 = __import__('urllib3')
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

# Configuration
AUCTION_ID = os.getenv("AUCTION_ID", "164145").strip()

def get_auction_data(auction_id):
    """Fetch all items from the auction API"""
    base_url = "https://bid.theconsignors.com/api/items/search"
    all_items = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        params = {
            "auction_id": auction_id,
            "query": "",
            "category": "All",
            "page": "active",
            "per_page": 100,
            "exact_category_match": "true"
        }

        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            if not data.get("items"):
                break

            all_items.extend(data["items"])

            if len(data["items"]) < 100 or len(all_items) >= data.get("total", 0):
                break

            page += 1
            params["page"] = page

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fetching page {page}: {e}")
            break

    return all_items

def download_item_images(item, images_dir):
    """Download images for a single item and return info"""
    lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "").replace("/", "-")
    if not lot_num:
        return None

    images = item.get("images", [])
    if not images:
        return {
            "lot": lot_num,
            "item_name": item.get("name", ""),
            "image_count": 0,
            "folder": "",
            "status": "No images"
        }

    lot_dir = images_dir / f"lot_{lot_num}"
    lot_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    downloaded_count = 0
    for idx, img in enumerate(images, 1):
        try:
            img_url = img.get("full_preview_url") or img.get("url")
            if not img_url:
                continue

            response = requests.get(img_url, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()

            # Determine file extension
            ext = ".jpg"
            if "png" in img_url.lower():
                ext = ".png"
            elif "webp" in img_url.lower():
                ext = ".webp"

            filepath = lot_dir / f"image_{idx:02d}{ext}"
            filepath.write_bytes(response.content)
            downloaded_count += 1

            # Rate limiting
            time.sleep(0.1)

        except Exception as e:
            pass  # Silently skip failed downloads

    return {
        "lot": lot_num,
        "item_name": item.get("name", "")[:60],
        "image_count": downloaded_count,
        "folder": f"lot_{lot_num}",
        "status": f"Downloaded {downloaded_count} images"
    }

def create_index_excel(items_with_images, auction_id):
    """Create Excel file with image index"""
    output_dir = Path.cwd() / "auction_exports"
    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Image Index"

    # Define styles
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F2937", end_color="1F2937", fill_type="solid")
    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
    border = Border(
        left=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        right=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        top=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        bottom=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3')
    )

    # Set headers
    headers = ["Lot #", "Item Name", "Images Downloaded", "Folder Name", "Status"]
    ws.append(headers)

    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
        cell.border = border

    # Add data
    for idx, item_data in enumerate(items_with_images, start=2):
        ws[f"A{idx}"] = item_data["lot"]
        ws[f"B{idx}"] = item_data["item_name"]
        ws[f"C{idx}"] = item_data["image_count"]
        ws[f"D{idx}"] = item_data["folder"]
        ws[f"E{idx}"] = item_data["status"]

        # Apply borders and alignment
        for col in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]:
            cell = ws[f"{col}{idx}"]
            cell.border = border
            if col == "C":
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
            else:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", wrap_text=True)

    # Set column widths
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 40
    ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["D"].width = 20
    ws.column_dimensions["E"].width = 30

    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"

    # Save file
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_ImageIndex_{timestamp}.xlsx"
    filepath = output_dir / filename

    wb.save(filepath)
    return filepath

def main():
    # Get auction ID
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        auction_id = sys.argv[1]
    else:
        print("=" * 70)
        print("IMAGE DOWNLOADER - Download All Auction Photos")
        print("=" * 70)
        print(f"\nDefault Auction ID: {AUCTION_ID}")
        print("\nEnter auction ID or press Enter to use default")
        user_input = input("Auction ID: ").strip()
        auction_id = user_input if user_input else AUCTION_ID

    # Fetch auction data
    print(f"\nFetching auction data for ID: {auction_id}...")
    items = get_auction_data(auction_id)

    if not items:
        print("No items found!")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        return

    print(f"Found {len(items)} items")

    # Create images directory
    images_dir = Path.cwd() / f"auction_{auction_id}_images"

    print(f"\nDownloading images to: {images_dir}")
    print("This may take 5-15 minutes depending on image count...\n")

    items_with_images = []
    total_downloaded = 0

    for idx, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")
        item_name = item.get("name", "")[:50]

        if idx % 50 == 0:

        # Download images
        result = download_item_images(item, images_dir)
        if result:

            if result["image_count"] > 0:
                total_downloaded += result["image_count"]

    print(f"\nDownload Complete!")
    print(f"  Total items: {len(items)}")
    print(f"  Items with images: {len([x for x in items_with_images if x['image_count'] > 0])}")
    print(f"  Total images downloaded: {total_downloaded}")

    # Create Excel index
    print(f"\nCreating image index Excel file...")

    print(f"All Done!")

    print(f"\nImages saved to:")
    print(f"  {images_dir}")
    print(f"\nImage index saved to:")
    print(f"  {excel_path}")
    print(f"\nFolder structure:")
    print(f"  auction_{auction_id}_images/")
    print(f"    lot_7036/")
    print(f"      image_01.jpg")
    print(f"      image_02.jpg")
    print(f"      ...")
    print(f"    lot_7037/")

if __name__ == "__main__":

import hashlib
import mimetypes
import time
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

import pandas as pd
import requests

from config import OUTPUT_DIR, IMAGE_DIR

INPUT = OUTPUT_DIR / "auction_lots_normalized.csv"

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 auction research image downloader",
    "Accept": "image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,image/svg+xml,image/*,*/*;q=0.8",
}


def ext_from_response(url, resp):
    ctype = resp.headers.get("content-type", "").split(";")[0].strip()
    ext = mimetypes.guess_extension(ctype) if ctype else None
    if ext in [".jpe"]:
        ext = ".jpg"
    if ext:
        return ext
    path_ext = Path(urlparse(url).path).suffix
    return path_ext if path_ext else ".jpg"


def safe_lot(lot):
    s = str(lot).strip().replace("/", "_").replace("\\", "_")
    return s or "unknown_lot"


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(INPUT, dtype=str).fillna("")
    manifest = []
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        lot = safe_lot(row.get("lot", ""))
        urls = [u.strip() for u in str(row.get("image_urls", "")).split("|") if u.strip()]
        lot_dir = IMAGE_DIR / lot
        lot_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for i, url in enumerate(urls, start=1):
            try:
                resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=30)
                resp.raise_for_status()
                ext = ext_from_response(url, resp)
                digest = hashlib.sha1(url.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:10]
                out = lot_dir / f"{lot}_{i:02d}_{digest}{ext}"
                out.write_bytes(resp.content)
                manifest.append({"lot": lot, "image_index": i, "url": url, "file": str(out)})
                print(f"Downloaded lot {lot} image {i}")
                time.sleep(0.15)

            data = response.json()

            if len(data["items"]) < 100 or len(all_items) >= data.get("total", 0):
                break

            print(f"Error fetching page {page}: {e}")

                # Try different possible URL fields
                url = img.get("full_preview_url") or img.get("url") or img.get("thumbnail_url")
                if url:
                    urls.append(url)

    for key in item.keys():
        if key in ["description", "simple_description", "formatted_simple_description"]:
            text = str(item.get(key, ""))

            import re
            found_urls = re.findall(r'https?://[^\s"<>]+(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp)', text, re.IGNORECASE)

    seen = set()
    unique_urls = []
    for url in urls:

            unique_urls.append(url)

import requests
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import time
import os
import sys
import json
import warnings
import hashlib
import mimetypes
from urllib.parse import urlparse

# Suppress SSL warnings
urllib3 = __import__('urllib3')
urllib3.disable_warnings(urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning)

# Configuration
AUCTION_ID = os.getenv("AUCTION_ID", "164145").strip()

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 auction research image downloader",
    "Accept": "image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,image/svg+xml,image/*,*/*;q=0.8",
}

def get_auction_data(auction_id):
    """Fetch all items from the auction API"""
    base_url = "https://bid.theconsignors.com/api/items/search"
    all_items = []
    page = 1

    while True:
        params = {
            "auction_id": auction_id,
            "query": "",
            "category": "All",
            "page": "active",
            "per_page": 100,
            "exact_category_match": "true"
        }

        try:
            response = requests.get(base_url, params=params, timeout=10, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()

            if not data.get("items"):
                break

            all_items.extend(data["items"])

            if len(data["items"]) < 100 or len(all_items) >= data.get("total", 0):
                break

            page += 1
            params["page"] = page

        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error fetching page {page}: {e}")
            break

    return all_items

def extract_image_urls(item):
    """Extract image URLs from item - try multiple approaches"""
    urls = []

    # Approach 1: Check images array
    if "images" in item and item["images"]:
        for img in item["images"]:
            if isinstance(img, dict):
                # Try different possible URL fields
                url = img.get("full_preview_url") or img.get("url") or img.get("thumbnail_url")
                if url:
                    urls.append(url)

    # Approach 2: Look for image URLs in description or other text fields
    for key in item.keys():
        if key in ["description", "simple_description", "formatted_simple_description"]:
            text = str(item.get(key, ""))
            # Find URLs in text
            import re
            found_urls = re.findall(r'https?://[^\s"<>]+(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp)', text, re.IGNORECASE)
            urls.extend(found_urls)

    # Remove duplicates while preserving order
    seen = set()
    unique_urls = []
    for url in urls:
        if url not in seen:
            seen.add(url)
            unique_urls.append(url)

    return unique_urls

def ext_from_url(url):
    """Determine file extension from URL"""
    try:
        response = requests.head(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=5, verify=False, allow_redirects=True)
        ctype = response.headers.get("content-type", "").split(";")[0].strip()
        ext = mimetypes.guess_extension(ctype) if ctype else None
        if ext == ".jpe":
            ext = ".jpg"
        if ext:
            return ext
    except:
        pass

    # Fallback: extract from URL
    path_ext = Path(urlparse(url).path).suffix.lower()
    return path_ext if path_ext else ".jpg"

def download_item_images(item, images_dir):
    """Download images for a single item"""
    lot_num = str(item.get("lot_identifier", "")).strip().replace("/", "-").replace("\\", "-")
    if not lot_num:
        return None

    item_name = item.get("name", "")[:60]
    image_urls = extract_image_urls(item)

    if not image_urls:
        return {
            "lot": lot_num,
            "item_name": item_name,
            "image_count": 0,
            "folder": "",
            "status": "No images found"
        }

    lot_dir = images_dir / f"lot_{lot_num}"
    lot_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    downloaded_count = 0
    for idx, url in enumerate(image_urls, 1):
        try:
            response = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=15, verify=False)
            response.raise_for_status()

            # Determine extension
            ext = ext_from_url(url)

            # Create filename with hash to avoid duplicates
            digest = hashlib.sha1(url.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:8]
            filename = f"{lot_num}_{idx:02d}_{digest}{ext}"
            filepath = lot_dir / filename

            filepath.write_bytes(response.content)
            downloaded_count += 1

            # Rate limiting
            time.sleep(0.15)

        except Exception as e:
            pass  # Silently skip failed downloads

    return {
        "lot": lot_num,
        "item_name": item_name,
        "image_count": downloaded_count,
        "folder": f"lot_{lot_num}",
        "status": f"Downloaded {downloaded_count} images"
    }

def create_index_excel(items_with_images, auction_id):
    """Create Excel file with image index"""
    output_dir = Path.cwd() / "auction_exports"
    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Image Index"

    # Define styles
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F2937", end_color="1F2937", fill_type="solid")
    header_font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF", size=11)
    border = Border(
        left=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        right=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        top=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3'),
        bottom=Side(style='thin', color='D3D3D3')
    )

    # Set headers
    headers = ["Lot #", "Item Name", "Images Downloaded", "Folder Name", "Status"]
    ws.append(headers)

    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True)
        cell.border = border

    # Add data
    for idx, item_data in enumerate(items_with_images, start=2):
        ws[f"A{idx}"] = item_data["lot"]
        ws[f"B{idx}"] = item_data["item_name"]
        ws[f"C{idx}"] = item_data["image_count"]
        ws[f"D{idx}"] = item_data["folder"]
        ws[f"E{idx}"] = item_data["status"]

        # Apply borders and alignment
        for col in ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]:
            cell = ws[f"{col}{idx}"]
            cell.border = border
            if col == "C":
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center")
            else:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", wrap_text=True)

    # Set column widths
    ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = 10
    ws.column_dimensions["B"].width = 40
    ws.column_dimensions["C"].width = 15
    ws.column_dimensions["D"].width = 20
    ws.column_dimensions["E"].width = 30

    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"

    # Save file
    timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
    filename = f"Auction_{auction_id}_ImageIndex_{timestamp}.xlsx"
    filepath = output_dir / filename

    wb.save(filepath)
    return filepath

def main():
    # Get auction ID
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        auction_id = sys.argv[1]
    else:
        print("=" * 70)
        print("IMAGE DOWNLOADER - Download All Auction Photos")
        print("=" * 70)
        print(f"\nDefault Auction ID: {AUCTION_ID}")
        print("\nEnter auction ID or press Enter to use default")
        user_input = input("Auction ID: ").strip()
        auction_id = user_input if user_input else AUCTION_ID

    # Fetch auction data
    print(f"\nFetching auction data for ID: {auction_id}...")
    items = get_auction_data(auction_id)

    if not items:
        print("No items found!")
        input("Press Enter to exit...")
        return

    print(f"Found {len(items)} items")

    # Create images directory
    images_dir = Path.cwd() / f"auction_{auction_id}_images"

    print(f"\nDownloading images to: {images_dir}")
    print("This may take 10-30 minutes depending on image count...\n")

    items_with_images = []
    total_downloaded = 0
    items_with_any_images = 0

    for idx, item in enumerate(items, 1):
        lot_num = item.get("lot_identifier", "")

        if idx % 50 == 0:
            print(f"Progress: {idx}/{len(items)} items processed, {total_downloaded} images downloaded...")

        # Download images
        result = download_item_images(item, images_dir)
        if result:
            items_with_images.append(result)
            if result["image_count"] > 0:
                total_downloaded += result["image_count"]
                items_with_any_images += 1

    print(f"\nDownload Complete!")
    print(f"  Total items: {len(items)}")
    print(f"  Items with images: {items_with_any_images}")
    print(f"  Total images downloaded: {total_downloaded}")

    # Create Excel index
    print(f"\nCreating image index Excel file...")
    excel_path = create_index_excel(items_with_images, auction_id)

    print(f"\n{'=' * 70}")
    print(f"All Done!")
    print(f"{'=' * 70}")
    print(f"\nImages saved to:")
    print(f"  {images_dir}")
    print(f"\nImage index saved to:")
    print(f"  {excel_path}")
    print(f"\nFolder structure:")
    print(f"  auction_{auction_id}_images/")
    print(f"    lot_7036/")
    print(f"      [image files]")
    print(f"    lot_7037/")
    print(f"      [image files]")
    print(f"    ...")

    input("\nPress Enter to exit...")

if __name__ == "__main__":
